detail.longDescription: This is especially obvious in the "Generative # AI " sphere. # GenAI zealots are constantly burbling about numbers which purportedly "prove" the irrational and patently ridiculous claims which the elite computer geeks make about their latest round of LLM garbage-generators. Most especially do they burble about # productivity because this is ultimately an emotional sort of metric: the computer geeks aren't actually producing anything , in fact the process of genAI sludge-making is highly destructive and appallingly wasteful of resources while producing nothing that can be trusted, but the computer geeks FEEL "productive" and thus cook up whatever statistics (usually involving mere bulk quantities of money and time and lines of output produced) in order to justify their emotional commitment to "productivity".
